quarterly_data.signal: Onto Innovation's 10-K states that fiscal 2025 revenue increased 2% compared to fiscal 2024, primarily due to higher sales to NAND and OSAT customers and revenue attributed to the acquired Semilab USA business, partially offset by lower sales to Foundry and DRAM customers.
